svg.text: VALHEIM COASTAL MEGA-BASE — VERTICAL SECTIONS, ELEVATION TRANSITIONS & CIRCULATION DIAGRAMS
Deliverable 3 | Verifying the Fixed +4.0 m Dreamhouse Floor, +2.0 m Outdoor Plaza (36×36 m), 0.0 m Ground Datum, and -1.5 m / -4.5 m Harbor Section
All Units in Meters (4.0 m Grausten Grid Aligned)

4. ANNOTATED CIRCULATION, TRAVEL TIMES & 20m SPAWN-SUPPRESSION GRID
Schematic Node-Link Workflow (Distances from Dreamhouse Storage Core) + 20m Workbench/Campfire Base Coverage
Dashed Orange Circle = 64m Active Animal Breeding Radius from Dreamhouse Center
(Measured Door-to-Door at Base Jog ~6.5 m/s | Cart Haul ~4.0 m/s)

• Full Perimeter Ring Loop: 368.0 m Total Loop (56 sec)
In Valheim, Player Base structures suppress all hostile & event spawns
within 20.0 m. By burying 25 Campfires (or Wards) on a 24 m × 24 m
grid beneath the 4×4m Grausten floor tiles, the 20m circles overlap
with zero dead spots (max diagonal half-span = 16.97 m < 20.0 m).
A 4.0 m wide × 2.5 m deep vertical-walled trench outside the 3.0 m
Grausten curtain wall prevents Trolls, Fulings, and Charred from
meleeing the wall while keeping ocean & meadow sightlines open.
Zone C sits 28–58 m from the Dreamhouse (well within Valheim's
64.0 m active AI radius), so Boars, Hens, Lox, and Asksvin breed
continuously while you craft or organize chests in the Dreamhouse.
